About Organization

Rajasthan Public Service Commission is a government agency responsible for conducting recruitment exams for various government jobs in Rajasthan. The commission was established in 1949 and is headquartered in Ajmer, Rajasthan.

The commission conducts exams for various posts, including senior teachers, in the state of Rajasthan. The exams are conducted in a fair and transparent manner, and the selected candidates are appointed to the respective posts.

About the Programme

The RPSC Senior Teacher Grade II TGT programme is a government job opportunity for graduates with relevant subjects. The programme is conducted by the Rajasthan Public Service Commission and is open to candidates who meet the eligibility criteria.

The programme aims to recruit senior teachers for various subjects, including Hindi, English, Sanskrit, Mathematics, Science, and Social Science. The selected candidates will be appointed to the respective posts in the state of Rajasthan.
